items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: Frank Early, yeah, he was on, right there too. He was on Liberty and, Liberty and Benville.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was a policeman then. I don't know. He was a policeman, yeah. Yeah, he, and then.
Somebody told me once a fellow by the name of Frank Early or someplace.

Frank Early, yeah, he was on, right there too. He was on Liberty and, Liberty and Benville. That's where he was, you know, he used to get so drunk sometimes he used to, didn't know how the automobile used to take him in the place. He used to run that place there.
